oracle.invariant: S1: every test passes, none skipped. S2: each of the fourteen is ready, its minVersion is the release re-measured (ja-spa 1.0.2, ja-space 1.0.3, ja-spark/stark/symphony/teline-v/titan/tour 1.0.1, ja-trip/vega/vogue 1.0.4, ja-vital 1.0.3, ja-voyara 1.0.5, purity-iii 1.0.1), its maxVersion is at or above it, its readyNote names tasks/evidence/ds-remeasure-5-2026-10-11/<slug> (whose after/verdicts.json exists), and it judges a running-text kind. Purity III's dark sheet gives .navbar color #444444 and .row-feature-primary #bbe6ff, keeps .row-feature a.thumbnail:has(img) white and inverts .poweredby .t3-logo, and its light sheet has no invert(; its text kinds read .features-intro. JA Voyara's .voy-price takes var(--ds-c-accent-text). JA Vogue's dark sheet inverts .logo-img and strokes .navbar-brand svg path with currentColor, its light sheet has no invert(. JA Teline V's dark sheet inverts .logo-img-sm. JA Tour's followRules give .article-more a accent-text and .link-primary accent-text!. S3: each at its minVersion -> {contract:'joomla-<slug>'}; the version before -> reason TEMPLATE_NEEDS_UPDATE. S4: a display:none ::before picture is not pictured; an inline static ::after icon is not; a positioned ::before picture covering the box is.
